messages:
elena_sales: Heads up — AegisFin wants a 2-week POC in eu-west1 starting next week. They asked for a dedicated pool, pref H100s, ~8 GPUs. They also require private networking + customer-managed KMS. Can infra confirm feasibility and lead time? cc @kai_infra @morgan_se @ana_security

kai_infra: Quick Qs: do we have expected qps/concurrency and average sequence length? H100 inventory in eu-west1 is tight; 72hr allocation window applies. If they need immediate start we may need a hybrid SKU approach. Also need to know if they want VPC peering or Private deployment.

elena_sales: They're estimating ~35-45 concurrent requests at peak, avg seq ~900-1100 tokens. Model: LlamaX-70B instruction-tuned (fp16). They prefer peering and will provide CIDR + KMS ARN. Billing is short-term invoice.

morgan_se: That concurrency + seq len suggests 8x H100 could be okay with aggressive batching + KV cache, but tail latency might suffer under spike. Two proposal variants to offer: (1) 8x H100 dedicated (fast, higher $), (2) 12x A100-80GB as a mixed pool (more headroom, lower cost). I'll estimate p95 latencies and delta cost.

ana_security: From sec side: need KMS ARN, confirmation keys remain in EU, data residency sign-off, and completed security intake (ATO-ish). If KMS is in customer account we need cross-account IAM role; that adds ~1-2 days. Also require allowed CIDR and egress rules for peering.

ops_provision_bot: Ops intake template (fill and paste back). Once completed I can run capacity check and create the pool if approved:

```json
{ "customer": "AegisFin", "env": "poc", "region": "eu-west1", "primary_sku": "H100:8", "alt_sku": "A100-80GB:12", "duration_days": "14", "concurrency": "40", "avg_seq_len": "1024", "model": "LlamaX-70B-instruct", "networking": "vpc_peering", "customer_cidr": "<CIDR>", "kms_required": "true", "kms_arn": "<kms-arn>", "billing_term": "short-term" }
```

kai_infra: FYI lead time notes: H100 lock in eu-west1 typically needs 72hrs lead. Cross-account KMS adds 1-2 days for IAM role + test. If they can accept a 48-72hr window we'll prioritize H100s; otherwise propose the mixed A100 fallback.

morgan_se: I'll attach quick perf sims and a sentence for the AE: expected p95 latencies ~1.1-1.6s on H100s with batching; on A100 mix expect ~1.4-2.2s p95. Cost delta ~25-40% depending on utilization.

elena_sales: Great — I'll ask sales AE to fill the JSON and grab CIDR + KMS ARN. Please hold a soft 72hr reservation if possible, @kai_infra.

ana_security: Once the filled intake is in, I'll review and sign off on security contingencies. Reminder to request data processing agreement for EU keys.

ops_provision_bot: Noted. Paste completed intake to this thread and tag @ana_security for approval. After approval ops will proceed to allocate pool and share endpoint and creds. :rocket:
